scope: System invariants already enforced by the current AtM baseline; future v1 invariants are added by the PR that implements them.

invariants.statement: Startup qualification must fail closed when the Flatpak application/runtime identity required by the current qualification policy cannot be established.
Invalid persisted repository state must not be overwritten or repaired implicitly by normal repository-state mutations.

A persisted repository snapshot may be reported ready only when the snapshot path is bound to the persisted SHA, manifest identity validates, the repository version matches, and the retrieval index is valid or is rebuilt from that same snapshot.
A repository snapshot whose integrity seal no longer matches its contents must not remain usable as ready current state.
Repository archive ingestion must enforce bounded extraction and reject unsafe paths or link-like archive entries before a snapshot can be promoted.
A retrieval index may be reused only when it validates against the exact repository and snapshot sources; an invalid derived index must be rejected and rebuilt or surface an error.
A conversation session may start only from frozen grounding and must keep the selected AI model identity, including its digest when available, pinned until the session is reset.
The same logical evidence object must expose the same structured semantic metadata regardless of whether it is discovered by exact, lexical, or tabular retrieval.

Only an explicit frozen AtM scientific profile rule matching the evidence repository and structural selector may produce TYPED_VALIDATED; repository payload text cannot grant itself scientific authority.
Textual, unsupported, provenance-incomplete, or profile-recognized malformed evidence must fail closed as a non-typed scientific classification and must never be silently promoted to TYPED_VALIDATED.

The EWD, CBD, and RMD v1 production profile factories are deny-by-default allowlists: only explicitly declared structural selectors and exact dataset logical source IDs may be recognized, and unlisted or near-match evidence remains unsupported.

Scientific control evidence must be read only through AtM-owned fixed repository/path/JSON-Pointer/type specifications from the pinned snapshot, without retrieval or textual fallback; unsafe paths, symlink traversal, unresolved pointers and type mismatches must fail closed.

SCI-04 must keep ScientificContentId, QualifiedArtifactId, and StorageDigest distinct: semantic content is canonically identified independently of storage/provenance, qualification binds that content to pinned provenance and semantic-profile identity, and storage digest covers the complete stored artifact; only TYPED_VALIDATED evidence or recognized deterministic controls may enter the artifact layer, and mutation or incomplete provenance must fail validation.
